name: Birdwatcher Phyllis

intro.text: Nightjars! Camouflaged like a bit of dead branch, and a call like a distant motorbike. I wait all day to hear it for five minutes.

win: Oh dear. I hope I haven't put the nightjar off.
after: The old name was goatsucker. They think it drank milk from goats. They were wrong, but it's a better name than 'Caprimulgus'.
